'''Sector/Imperial Liaison''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Legal Division]]. The subdivision was responsible for representing the Authority's interests to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
